study: Conditional absolute convergence threshold for the tangent series
status: complete mathematical proof; source statement verification only; not Lean formalized
series: sum over positive integers n of abs(tan(n)) / n^s, with angles in radians and s real

convergence_hypothesis.statement: For every real alpha > 2, there exists an integer Q >= 2 such that for every integer p and every integer q >= Q, abs(pi - p/q) >= q^(-alpha).
convergence_hypothesis.uniformity: Q may depend on alpha, but not on p or q; no coprimality restriction is imposed.
convergence_hypothesis.scope: all integer numerators and all sufficiently large positive integer denominators
convergence_hypothesis.equivalent_input_for_this_proof: For each alpha > 2 there exists c_alpha > 0 with abs(pi - p/q) >= c_alpha q^(-alpha) for all p in Z and q >= 1.
convergence_hypothesis.small_denominator_justification: H implies pi irrational. Given Q from H, set c = min(1, min over 1 <= q < Q of q^(alpha-1) dist(q*pi, Z)); then c > 0 and the global bound holds.

convergence_result.statement: Under H the absolute series converges for every real s > 1.
convergence_result.fixed_exponent_form: For a single alpha > 2 satisfying the eventual lower bound, convergence follows whenever s > alpha - 1.
convergence_result.dyadic_estimate: sum_{N <= n < 2N} abs(tan(n)) <= (4 * 3^(alpha-1) / c) * N^(alpha-1) * (1 + log N), for integer N >= 1.
convergence_result.pole_distance: For 1 <= n <= 2N the nearest tangent pole has positive odd denominator q <= 3N and even numerator p = 2n; distance is >= delta_N.
convergence_result.mutual_spacing: For distinct n,m in [1,2N], the circular gap modulo pi is >= delta_N, by approximating pi with h/r where h = abs(n-m), r is a nearest nonnegative integer to h/pi, and r = 0 is handled separately.
convergence_result.parity_warning: Pole distance uses even numerators and odd denominators. Mutual spacing uses unrestricted numerators and denominators. A bound restricted to the pole parity class alone is not enough for the stated spacing argument.
convergence_result.packing: Split signed distances to the pole into the two half-circles. On each side the jth distance is >= j*delta_N; the reciprocal sum is bounded by a harmonic sum.

divergence_result.statement: The absolute series diverges to positive infinity for every real s <= 1, independently of H.
inputs: The usual real trigonometric addition formulas and abs(sin x) <= abs(tan x) whenever cos x is nonzero.
cos(n) is nonzero for all positive integers n, as follows from the standard irrationality of pi.

nonclaims: No proof of the irrationality exponent statement H is provided.
No Lean formalization or executed Lean verification of this tangent-series result is claimed.
No assertion about conditional convergence of the signed tangent series for s <= 1 is made.
No uniform O(N log N) block bound is claimed from H alone.
No sharp pointwise growth exponent or parity-restricted irrationality exponent is claimed.
